mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, writer_id, parent_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{parentId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, post_id, writer_id AS member_id, parent_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, c.writer_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS writerNickname,
CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '삭제된 댓글입니다.' ELSE c.content END AS content, c.created_at, c.updated_at, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS deleted FROM comment c JOIN members m ON m.member_id = c.writer_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.comment_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
